items.title: What the Coming 6G Trials With Nvidia, T-Mobile Could Mean for Nokia Investors
items.summary: Nokia stock has surged nearly 150% over the past year on the promise of AI-powered 6G, and now Nvidia and T-Mobile are putting that promise to a real-world test. What the trial results could mean for shareholders depends on a question Nokia has not yet answered.
